verdict.rationale: mParticle has documented Data Privacy Controls that capture consent/opt-out state (GDPR consent, CCPA data sale opt-out) and Consent Filters that enforce forwarding rules to downstream partners (e.g., 'Do not forward if CCPA Data sale opt out is present'), directly matching the story of automatic downstream enforcement. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that enforcement works reliably across all destination types, and detail on consent category granularity beyond GDPR/CCPA.
